lines.intro: Welcome to SpaceBook Library. Let's take a quick tour of the app.
lines.lib_open: This is the Library. Every class, one to twelve, with its real textbook covers. Tap a class, and its books appear.
lines.c1: Class 1. Six colourful books to begin: English, Maths, Islamyat, Nazira Quran, Pashto and Drawing.
lines.c2: Class 2. Eight books. Urdu and General Knowledge join, so children read in their own language.
lines.c3: Class 3. Seven books, led by English, Maths and General Knowledge.
lines.c4: Class 4. Eight books. General Science and Social Studies begin, in English and Urdu medium.
lines.c5: Class 5. Eight books. Science, Urdu and Social Studies grow stronger.
lines.c6: Class 6. Thirteen books. Computer, Geography, History and Arabic are added.
lines.c7: Class 7. Twelve books, with Geography, History, Arabic and Mutalia-e-Quran.
lines.c8: Class 8. Thirteen books. Pashto returns, beside Arabic and Computer Education.
lines.c9: Class 9. Fourteen books. Physics, Chemistry and Biology each become their own book.
lines.c10: Class 10. Fourteen books for the board year, at exam level.
lines.c11: Class 11. Fourteen books. Statistics, Civics and Islamic History join.
lines.c12: Class 12. Fifteen books, including Economics. The last year before college.
lines.s2_open: Now let's open a book. Class 1, English.
lines.s2_unit: Choose a unit, then open its Exercise tab.
lines.s2_sentence: Tap any sentence, to see its meaning in Urdu and Pashto.
lines.s2_speak: Press the speaker, and the app reads it aloud.
lines.s2_word: Hold a single word, to see just its meaning.
lines.s2_match: Page one. Match each picture with its letter sound: tap the picture, then its letter.
lines.s2_p2: Page two. Choose the right word for the gap. A wrong answer says try again; the right one jumps into place.
lines.s3_chapter: Chapter 3 is Laws of Integers and Order of Operations.
lines.s3_ex: Open Exercise 3.7, question one, part E. The bottom arrows turn the pages.
lines.s3_ans: Tap Ans, and the whole step by step solution appears at once.
lines.s3_anim: Or tap Animate, and watch the question being solved on the board. First, the bar: five minus three is two.
lines.s3_next1: Next step. Inside the brackets, seven times two is fourteen.
lines.s3_next2: Then ten plus seven plus fourteen makes thirty one.
lines.s3_next3: Now twenty times thirty one is six hundred and twenty.
lines.s3_end: And finally, seven hundred twenty five minus six hundred twenty leaves one hundred five. The answer.
lines.outro: SpaceBook. Read, learn and play. Coming soon.
